item.title: Protestors gather in Ruston Sunday
item.description: Residents urge ICE accountability in fatal shooting By Nancy Bergeron — nancy@rustonleader.com Sunday, January 11, 2026 Leader photo by Nancy Bergeron Protestors near Railroad Park in Ruston hold signs to urge accountability of ICE agents in the death of Renee Good in Minneapolis. The protest took place Sunday afternoon. Approximately 85 people clad in black and carrying homemade signs condemning recent actions by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents stood along the sidewalks on Rusto

item.title: Ruston takes out Central
item.description: Bearcats advance to state title game — Matt Belinson Thursday, March 12, 2026 Photo by Bret McCormick LAKE CHARLES - The 38-year drought is over. For the first time since 1988, Ruston will play for a state championship in basketball after the Bearcats (23-3) defeated Central-Baton Rouge 71-57 in the Division I nonselect state semifinal Thursday evening at Burton Coliseum as the Bearcats' Big Three of KeShun Malcolm, Ahmad Hudson, and Darren Ford showed out on both ends of the floor to move Rusto
